How to Set Up a WhatsApp Proxy and Check the Connection

Configure WhatsApp's in-app proxy, verify message delivery, and troubleshoot connection failures using the official guidance.

When WhatsApp has trouble connecting, check whether other apps work, whether WhatsApp is up to date, and whether the issue occurs on both Wi-Fi and mobile data. The app's proxy feature expects a WhatsApp-compatible endpoint. Obtain the address from a trusted operator or your organization's network administrator.

Steps

  1. Confirm that the proxy supports WhatsApp

    Ask the operator for the address, any required ports, and the features the service supports. The in-app proxy setting is separate from the system's HTTP or SOCKS proxy setting. Check compatibility before buying a general-purpose proxy plan for this use.

  2. Enter the address in WhatsApp

    In WhatsApp, open Settings, then Storage and data, and find Proxy. Enable the feature, enter the address supplied by the operator, and save it. Follow the official help page for your platform if the interface differs. Wait for the app's connection status before testing.

  3. Check incoming and outgoing messages

    Send a simple message to a known contact or a test group and ask someone to reply. Verify text first, then check media or other features that matter to you. If sending and receiving behave differently, note the time, active network, and any error before contacting the operator.

    If the connection fails, recheck the address and port, try another network you are authorized to use, or ask the operator to confirm availability. Turn the proxy off in the app after a temporary test if you need your previous connection back.

Frequently asked questions

What can a proxy operator see?

WhatsApp messages and calls remain end-to-end encrypted. The operator may see the IP address that connects to the proxy, so use a trusted provider and review the official guidance.

Can I paste a standard redrock address into the app?

Check with the provider that it offers a service compatible with WhatsApp's in-app proxy. Use the address and port the operator confirms for that feature.
